meta.mix: 3 Mercury Drug, 2 South Star Drug, 2 Generika Drugstore, 1 Watsons, 2 independents (New Nazareno Drugstore, Nagadrug Corporation)
meta.notes: Real pharmacy identities for the POC seed. Coordinates are map-verified; see coordinate_source per record. Hours/phone null means not published or not verifiable from the cited sources. Prices, stock, and verification dates are intentionally out of scope and remain mocked in the POC.

pharmacies.name: Mercury Drug – Naga City Peñafrancia
pharmacies.address: Panganiban St. cor. Peñafrancia St., Naga City, 4400 Camarines Sur
pharmacies.barangay_source: OSM reverse geocode; the official branch page does not state a barangay
pharmacies.coordinate_source: Mercury Drug official branch page OpenLayers map; OSM node 642883253 is within ~2 m
pharmacies.notes: Official branch page gives the exact map point and phone numbers. Barangay is inferred from OSM and should not be shown as official.

pharmacies.name: Mercury Drug – Naga City Concepcion Grande
pharmacies.address: 48 Maharlika Highway, Zone 4, Concepcion Grande, Naga City, 4400 Camarines Sur
pharmacies.coordinate_source: OSM way 1415534323 (Mercury Drug Concepcion Grande); Google Maps pin 13.621204, 123.218751 is within ~10 m. The official branch page map returns (0, 0).
pharmacies.notes: The official branch page's map coordinate is broken (0, 0); OSM and Google agree on the location. OSM reverse geocoding labels the point Concepcion Grande/Cararayan; the official address is authoritative for the barangay.

pharmacies.name: Mercury Drug – Naga City Puregold
pharmacies.address: Puregold Naga, ALDP Mall, Diversion Rd., Triangulo, Naga City, 4400 Camarines Sur
pharmacies.coordinate_source: Mercury Drug official branch page OpenLayers map; OSM node 11997719209 is within ~16 m
pharmacies.notes: Branch is inside Puregold Naga / ALDP Mall.

pharmacies.name: South Star Drug – SSD Naga 3
pharmacies.address: Crown Hotel Bldg., E. Angeles St. cor. P. Burgos St., San Francisco, Naga City, Camarines Sur
pharmacies.coordinate_source: FDA registry record CDRR-RV-DS-24344; OSM node 642881374, NusaList's P. Burgos listing, and Google Maps all agree within ~12 m
pharmacies.notes: Barangay boundary caveat: the official address says San Francisco, while OSM reverse geocoding of the Crown Hotel corner returns Santa Cruz/Lerma. This is a corner-building boundary discrepancy, not a location error.

pharmacies.name: South Star Drug – SSD Naga 15
pharmacies.address: #77 Concepcion Pequeña, Naga City, Camarines Sur
pharmacies.coordinate_source: OSM node 4157403495 (South Star Drug, Panganiban Drive, Concepcion Pequeña). FDA record CDRR-RV-DS-19955 gives 13.621393, 123.197710, ~280 m west and only ~35 m from the FDA point for SSD Naga 13, so the registry point is treated as approximate/duplicated.
pharmacies.notes: Branch identity is inferred from an OSM pharmacy node on Panganiban Drive; there is no independent storefront pin. Confirm by phone before recruitment. Fallback: South Star Naga 13 (McKay Bldg., Panganiban Drive; 24 hours; +63 923 742 1466; FDA 13.621710, 123.197710).

pharmacies.name: Generika Drugstore – CMS Naga LCC CBD2
pharmacies.address: G/F LCC Mall, Bicol Central Station CBD2, Brgy. Triangulo, Naga City, Camarines Sur
pharmacies.coordinate_source: OSM way 1202549804 (LCC Naga CBD 2, Ninoy and Cory Avenue, at the Bicol Central Station complex). The official Generika locator emits 13.620470, 123.219240, ~3.2 km east and inconsistent with the Bicol Central Station address.
pharmacies.notes: The pin is the LCC Naga CBD 2 building, not a surveyed Generika door. The official locator coordinate is treated as a data error. Barangay boundary caveat: the official address says Triangulo; the OSM mall polygon sits in Lerma, adjacent to Triangulo.

pharmacies.name: Generika Drugstore – CMS Naga San Felipe
pharmacies.address: Blk. 1, Lot 16, Parkview Executive Village, San Felipe, Naga City, Camarines Sur
pharmacies.coordinate_source: Generika official store page (wpslMap). OSM reverse geocoding confirms San Felipe; OSM LCC Supermarket San Felipe node 11152552034 is ~160 m away. Google's Parkview Executive Village geocode is ~800 m east.
pharmacies.notes: The official locator's phone field is empty; collect the number during recruitment. The FDA record for this branch repeats a clearly wrong default coordinate (13.627880, 123.187510) and was not used. The exact subdivision/block pin is not fully settled, but the official locator coordinate is the best available and cross-checks to San Felipe.

pharmacies.name: Watsons – SM City Naga
pharmacies.address: GF, SM City Naga Mall Area, Central Business District II, Brgy. Triangulo, Naga City, 4400 Camarines Sur
pharmacies.coordinate_source: Google Maps place pin linked from the official Watsons store page; OSM node 5112522941 is ~110 m south inside the same SM City Naga footprint
pharmacies.notes: This is the main Watsons store, not the SM Department Store or SM Supermarket counters.

pharmacies.name: New Nazareno Drugstore
pharmacies.address: Pav. 5, Panganiban Drive, Naga City, Camarines Sur
pharmacies.barangay_source: OSM reverse geocode; neither the FDA record nor the NusaList listing states a barangay
pharmacies.coordinate_source: FDA registry record CDRR-RV-DS-223011; OSM reverse geocoding confirms Panganiban Drive, Concepcion Pequeña. NusaList and Google pins sit 0.5–0.7 km west.
pharmacies.notes: Phone is from NusaList; hours were not published. Confirm both at recruitment.

pharmacies.name: Nagadrug Corporation
pharmacies.address: Door 8, Pav. 1, Panganiban Drive, Triangulo, Naga City, Camarines Sur
pharmacies.coordinate_source: FDA registry record CDRR-RV-DS-1617544; OSM node 6818835769 / Google Maps building pin at Door 8 Pavilion 1 is ~27 m south (13.621871, 123.194559)
pharmacies.notes: The FDA registry point is on Panganiban Drive in front of the building; the OSM/Google building pin is ~27 m south. The FDA address says Triangulo, while OSM reverse geocoding returns Tinago; the FDA address is authoritative for the seed.
